en.title: Read the supplied Spine binary byte window
en.body: A binary skeleton can be supplied as a subarray of a larger file, including a Node.js Buffer view. The loader reads exactly the supplied bytes and rejects a truncated skeleton even when its missing bytes follow the view.

zh.title: 按提供的字节范围读取 Spine 二进制骨骼
zh.body: 二进制骨骼可以取自大文件中的一段，包括 Node.js Buffer 子视图。加载器只读取这段字节。即使底层文件紧接着保存了缺失的内容，截断的骨骼也会按原有错误返回。
